m.satin.name: Satin
m.twoRails.oddDropped: Odd number of clicks: the last point had no pair and was dropped.
m.twoRails.tooFew: At least two pairs of points are needed: keep clicking, one point per rail.
m.split.autoDirection: One or more parts have no direction line: their stitches run across the long side. Check that this is right.
m.split.notOneColumn: In one or more parts the direction crosses the shape more than once: only the longest stretch is sewn. Add a cut where the shape forks.
m.tool.twoRails: Two-rail satin: left click = straight point, right click = curved point, rail 1 and rail 2 in turn; Enter makes it, Esc cancels
m.tool.split: Split and direct: drag with the left button for cut lines (brown), with the right one for direction lines (red); Enter applies, Esc cancels
m.twoRails.studioOnly: The two-rail satin is used in Studio.
m.split.selectShape: Select a filled shape to split first.
m.split.nothing: This shape cannot be turned into satins.
